correctness.rationale: The potential-coordinate enumeration proves an exact all-n Ehrhart formula, and Bernoulli/Faulhaber and magic coefficient transforms are algebraic identities. All m<=19 rational sign cases are exhaustive and replicated by independent interpolation from exact graph counts; m>=20 follows for every integer m from the strictly negative c_{m,m-19} forced by B20=-174611/330. Geometry and lattice normalization follow from connected graph incidence total unimodularity. Computations are not used to extrapolate infinite claims.

originality.rationale: The complete magic- and ordinary-positivity thresholds for every polar K_{2,m} is not in the primary references inspected. Konoike has a finite table through m=11, which is credited; Liu–Tsuchiya give the analogous Bernoulli ordinary coefficient sign for order polytopes, credited. New coverage is m12..19 magic signs plus the complete all-dimensional graph-polar comparison between ordinary and magic positivity, with a precise formula. Priority remains provisional under alternative representations.
residual_risks: Different terminology (tension/Lipschitz polytopes) may contain an equivalent all-m magic classification.

value.rationale: Magic positivity for polar symmetric edge polytopes is a motivating current research topic with an existing unexplained finite K2m table. A complete sharp classification for all integers m, together with an exact Ehrhart and magic coefficient formula and an infinite Bernoulli obstruction, settles a natural structural family question. It is not an arbitrary isolated instance or a finite enumeration without an infinite theorem.
